newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Rodman lifts Jones Apparel estimate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Rodman lifts Jones Apparel estimate.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it raised its estimate for Jones Apparel Group Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.75 from $1.70 to reflect continued positive momentum.
-- Rodman said Jones Apparel's product lines had a strong holiday season, and the company made assurances there were no fundamental changes to its future earnnings outlook.
-- Rodman remains comfortable with its earnings estimate of $1.46 for fiscal 1996, up from $1.19 from 1995.
-- Jones Apparel will report results on February 11.
-- The company makes women's suits and sportswear. Its stock was down 5/8 Tuesday afternoon at 35-1/2.
